explanation: At x ∈ {0, 1}, B_{n,α} f(x) = f(x) (for n ≥ 1 at x = 1), so √n(B_{n,α} f(x) − f(x)) → 0, which equals μ_α √(x(1−x)) f'(x) since √(x(1−x)) = 0. A true, elementary statement, proved in the file. It is consistent with Abel's problem (CTF Sozopol 2010) but does not rely on the conjectured formula in the interior. Correct.
